pokedexEntries.bk: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.

pokedexEntries.wh: They employ an electrically charged web to trap their prey. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: It creates barriers from electrified silk that stun foes. This works as a weapon as well as a defense.

pokedexEntries.x: They employ an electrically charged web to trap their prey. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it.

pokedexEntries.or: They employ an electrically charged web to trap their prey. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it.

pokedexEntries.y: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.

pokedexEntries.as: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.

pokedexEntries.sw: It launches electrified fur from its abdomen as its means of attack. Opponents hit by the fur could be in for three full days and nights of paralysis.

pokedexEntries.sh: It lays traps of electrified threads near the nests of bird Pokémon, aiming to snare chicks that are not yet good at flying.
